name: Kopia
description: Encrypted, deduplicated backups to local disks or cloud storage

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Kopia's repository connection (with the saved repository password), policies and this install's web UI password (.icestore-password). Keep it private.

paths.name: Cache
paths.description: Cache of downloaded backup data. Safe to empty.

paths.name: Repository
paths.description: A place for a backup repository on this disk. Pick /repository as the folder when you create a Local Directory repository, or use a cloud or another disk instead.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your MOS storage, read-only, to back up. Pick folders under /data, like /data/Documents.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Your other MOS disks, like /media/HDD-Storage. Use a folder here as the repository to keep backups on a second disk.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Kopia web UI and API, published on host as 6802

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: KOPIA_SERVER_USERNAME
variables.description: The user name for the Kopia web page. The password is made on first start and shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS.
